pick.name: Granola
pick.what: Bot-free AI meeting notes that capture device audio and merge with your own notes
pick.why: Best-regarded bot-free workflow; notes shaped by what you typed
pick.free_limits: Basic $0: 30-day history, limited AI chat, Slack integration only; Business $14/user/mo; Enterprise $35
pick.maintained: Windows availability confirmed by help centre; launch date sources conflict

best_free.name: Fathom
best_free.what: Meeting recorder bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams with AI summaries
best_free.free_limits: Free forever: unlimited recordings and transcription, instant AI summaries; some AI features marked 'limited use' (cap not stated on pricing page); Premium $16/mo annual or $20 monthly

alts.name: Meetily
alts.what: Local meeting transcriber with Ollama or API summaries
alts.why: Audio never leaves the machine; no bot
alts.free_limits: Free; LLM costs depend on provider

alts.name: Google Meet 'Take notes for me'
alts.why: Convenient if you host calls in Meet
alts.free_limits: Requires Google AI Pro/Ultra or Workspace; meetings you host; 8 languages

alts.name: Otter.ai
alts.what: free Basic 300 min/user/mo, 30 min per conversation; Pro USD 8.33/user/mo annual.  Replaces 'Gemini notes in Google Meet'

candidates.name: Granola
candidates.verdict: PICK: bot-free, best notes UX; free tier limited to 30 days of history

candidates.name: Google Meet notes
candidates.verdict: Only if you host on Meet

decision: Granola is the best meeting-notes tool for a founder: no bot joins, notes are shaped by what you typed, and it works on Mac and Windows. Fathom Free is the best free option when a bot is acceptable. Use a local tool like Meetily for regulated or confidential calls.
note: Same pick as Sales + GTM. For regulated or health data, use a local recorder and get consent.
details: Recording consent laws vary by country and US state; announce recording. Verify with a lawyer.
